post.text:
No one laughs at your dad jokes like a hyena

[🎞️ animalwhispers88]
https://t.co/BoymxDQliB
post.author_description: Engineer. Selecting and curating pictures and videos trying to awaken your sense of wonder since 2014. Science, tech, art, weather, space, the unusual around us

description.description: A series of video frames showing a man telling jokes to a spotted hyena named Eddie. In the first two frames, the man and Eddie are in a car wearing matching red knit beanies with 'Eddie's Pack' patches. Eddie appears to laugh or yawn at the man's jokes. In the third frame, they are in a Different car with orange seats, and in the fourth frame, they are indoors seated on a leather sofa against a log cabin wall.
description.ocrText: EDDIE'S PACK @ANIMALWHISPERS88 EDDIE! DID YOU KNOW I ONCE BOUGHT A DOG FROM A BLACKSMITH? EDDIE'S PACK @ANIMALWHISPERS88 @ANIMALWHISPERS88 NOW I TALK WITH AN AXE SCENT @ANIMALWHISPERS88 HEY EDDIE, HAVE YOU HEARD OF THE NEW MOVIE CALLED CONSTIPATION?

tweetMedia.transcription: Eddie, did you know I once bought a dog from a blacksmith? As soon as we got it home, it made a bolt for the door. Hey, Eddie, I accidentally sprayed Axe Body Spray into my mouth. Now I talk with an ax... Hey, Eddie, have you heard of the new movie called Constipation? Hasn't come out yet. Candy, do you know I have a fear of German sausages? I always fear the worst.
